symptoms: Thyroid Storm: High fever, severe tachycardia, delirium, agitation, high-output cardiac failure
Myxoedema Coma: Hypothermia, severe bradycardia, altered mental status, hypoventilation, hyponatraemia

management_steps.details:
1. Beta-blocker: Propranolol 60-80mg PO q4h OR Esmolol 250-500ug/kg load then 50-100 ug/kg/min.
2. Thionamide: Propylthiouracil (PTU) 600-1000mg load then 300mg PO q6h OR Methimazole 20-30mg PO q6h.
3. Steroid: Hydrocortisone 100mg IV STAT then q8h.
4. Iodine: Lugol's iodine 4-8 drops PO q6h (given at least 60 min AFTER thionamide).
Levothyroxine 300-500 ug (6ug/kg IBW) IV load, then 50ug daily + Hydrocortisone 100mg IV q8h.

warnings: In Thyroid Storm, administer Lugol's iodine AT LEAST 60 minutes AFTER PTU/Methimazole to prevent organification of iodine into new thyroid hormone.
